about: The ladder's bots (scripts/arena_ladder.py, G9-D9): display label, colour group, parent, and the prior relative to the parent where an estimate from outside the registered feeds exists. A prior from the registered feeds themselves would count the same boards twice, so none is taken from them. 'estimate' is in IMPs a board from the bot's side against its parent; 'tricks': true marks a bench figure in tricks, converted at 3.8 IMPs a trick (E9-0) with 10% on the conversion. Bots without an estimate get the weak prior (SD 2 IMPs a board at the field mean).
anchor_note: BEN (64): an outside bot that does not change between generations, with boards against every generation from Gen 6 on.
